title: Discovery and independent verification of the Proth prime 21952207 × 2^33326 + 1
description_html:
We report the discovery and primality proof of the Proth number

21952207 × 2^33326 + 1.

The result was independently verified using distinct PARI/GP and Python-based verification paths. A reproducible audit of public databases, project records, repositories, archives, and indexed sources was performed on 13 August 2026. No prior exact public occurrence or documented public interval overlap was found in the sources consulted.

Accordingly, the result is conservatively classified as a publicly unrecorded candidate as of the audit date. This statement does not exclude private, unpublished, unindexed, or otherwise inaccessible prior computation.

The deposit contains the primality evidence, independent-verification material, software versions, commands, audit evidence, cryptographic hashes, and reproducibility metadata.
